metadata.name: Limacina helicina laboratory incubation dataset 2019
metadata.description: Measurements of the marine pteropod Limacina helicina collected in laboratory incubations in September 2019. The dataset includes physical‑chemical parameters such as temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, DIC, total alkalinity, pH, and carbonate system variables for different sample types (control, incubation, initial collection) and treatment conditions.
